entities.summary:
Tony Peter Niemistö is a semi-retired Swedish musician, best known as Tony Reno, the original drummer in the rock band Europe. He played on Europe's first two albums, Europe and Wings of Tomorrow. He was fired from the band by producer Thomas Erdtman
without informing the band members before the second leg of the Wings of Tomorrow tour in 1984. He was replaced by Ian Haugland.
